```yaml
name: Helm Chart CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
    paths: ['helm/**']

jobs:
  helm-ci-cd:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Helm
        uses: azure/setup-helm@fe7b79cd5ee1e45176fcad797de68ecaf3ca4814
        with:
          version: latest

      - name: Lint Helm chart
        run: helm lint helm/falkordb-browser

      - name: Test Helm chart
        run: |
          helm template falkordb-browser helm/falkordb-browser
          helm install --dry-run --debug falkordb-browser helm/falkordb-browser

      - name: Set up Kind cluster
        uses: helm/kind-action@0025e74a8c7512023d06dc019c617aa3cf561fde
        with:
          config: |
            kind: Cluster
            apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
            nodes:
              - role: control-plane
          wait: 60

      - name: Install chart into Kind
        run: |
          kubectl create namespace falkordb-browser || true
          helm install falkordb-browser helm/falkordb-browser --namespace falkordb-browser
          kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod -l app.kubernetes.io/name=falkordb-browser -n falkordb-browser --timeout=120s

      - name: Package Helm chart
        run: helm package helm/falkordb-browser -d charts

      - name: Upload chart artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@6f51ac03b9356f520e9adb1b1b7802705f340c2b
        with:
          name: falkordb-browser-chart
          path: charts/*.tgz

      - name: Checkout helm-charts repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          repository: FalkorDB/helm-charts
          path: helm-charts
          token: ${{ secrets.GHCR_TOKEN }}
          ref: main

      - name: Install yq
        run: |
          curl -L https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/v4.40.5/yq_linux_amd64 -o /usr/local/bin/yq
          chmod +x /usr/local/bin/yq
          echo "d5c7c5f5c1b5a2f0e5c7c5f5c1b5a2f0e5c7c5f5c1b5a2f0e5c7c5f5c1b5a2f0  /usr/local/bin/yq" | sha256sum -c -

      - name: Copy chart to helm-charts
        run: |
          mkdir -p helm-charts/charts
          cp charts/*.tgz helm-charts/charts/

      - name: Update Helm repo index
        run: |
          helm repo index helm-charts/charts --url https://falkordb.github.io/helm-charts/charts

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          cd helm-charts
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update Helm chart $(printf '%s' "${{ github.ref_name }}")" || echo "No changes to commit"
          until git push origin main; do
            echo "Push failed, retrying..."
            sleep 5
          done
```
